{{velocity output="false"}} #set ($rfcClassName = 'RFC.Code.RFCClass') #** * Displays one property of the RFC object as a definition list entry. In view mode the entry can be edited in place. * * @param $propertyName the name of the property to display *# #macro (displayRFCProperty $propertyName) $escapetool.xml($doc.displayPrettyName($propertyName, false, false)) #set ($hint = $rfcClass.get($propertyName).hint) #if ($editing && "$!hint" != '') $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render($hint)) #end
$doc.display($propertyName)
#end #** * Outputs HTML that may contain user-controlled text (titles, user names) in a wiki syntax context. The HTML goes * through a non-wiki HTML macro and the macro syntax markers are neutralized, exactly as the platform does for the * output of $doc.display(), so that a title containing macro syntax is displayed and never executed. (Do not write * the velocity macro's own opening marker anywhere in this page, even in a comment: the wiki parser would take it for * a nested macro and swallow the whole page.) * * @param $html the HTML to output, already escaped for HTML *# #macro (displaySafeHTML $html) {{html clean="false" wiki="false"}}$html.replace('{{', '{{'){{/html}}## #end #** * Displays a read-only definition list entry. * * @param $labelKey the translation key of the label * @param $value the HTML to display as value (may contain user-controlled text) *# #macro (displayRFCEntry $labelKey $value)
#displaySafeHTML($value)
#end #** * Displays links to the given RFC pages, separated by commas. The label of a link is "RFC 42: title" when the RFC has * a number and the title otherwise. * * @param $references the document references to link to *# #macro (displayRFCLinks $references) #foreach ($reference in $references) #set ($linkedDocument = $xwiki.getDocument($reference)) #set ($linkedObject = $linkedDocument.getObject($rfcClassName)) #set ($linkedNumber = $NULL) #if ($linkedObject) #set ($linkedNumber = $linkedObject.getValue('number')) #end #if ("$!linkedNumber" != '') #set ($linkLabel = $services.localization.render('rfc.sheet.linkLabel', [$linkedNumber, $linkedDocument.plainTitle])) #else #set ($linkLabel = $linkedDocument.plainTitle) #end $escapetool.xml($linkLabel)#if ($foreach.hasNext), #end #end #end #** * Collects the RFC pages, viewable by the current user, that match the given query on the RFC object. * * @param $statement the XWQL statement, with a "rfc" alias for the RFC object * @param $bindings the named values to bind * @param $result the name of the variable that receives the list of document references *# #macro (findRFCs $statement $bindings $result) #set ($macro.references = []) #set ($macro.query = $services.query.xwql($statement).addFilter('hidden')) #foreach ($entry in $bindings.entrySet()) #set ($discard = $macro.query.bindValue($entry.key, $entry.value)) #end #foreach ($item in $macro.query.execute()) #set ($macro.reference = $services.model.resolveDocument($item)) #if ($services.security.authorization.hasAccess('view', $macro.reference)) #set ($discard = $macro.references.add($macro.reference)) #end #end #set ($result = $NULL) #setVariable("$result" $macro.references) #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #set ($rfcObject = $doc.getObject($rfcClassName)) #if (!$rfcObject) #if ($doc.fullName == 'RFC.Code.RFCSheet') {{info}}{{translation key="rfc.sheet.description"/}}{{/info}} #else {{warning}}{{translation key="rfc.sheet.noObject"/}}{{/warning}} #end #else #set ($rfcClass = $rfcObject.xWikiClass) #set ($discard = $doc.use($rfcObject)) #set ($editing = $xcontext.action == 'edit') ## Needed for in-place editing. #set ($discard = $xwiki.jsfx.use('uicomponents/edit/editableProperty.js', { 'forceSkinAction': true, 'language': $xcontext.locale })) #if ($editing) ## Propose the next free number to a new RFC (or to an RFC that has none yet). The author sees it and can change it. #if ("$!rfcObject.getValue('number')" == '') ## The pages with the highest numbers (selecting page names keeps the query allowed without programming right). ## Pages the current user cannot view are skipped, so the proposed number may be taken in that rare case; the ## sheet then shows a warning on both pages. #set ($highestNumbered = $services.query.xwql("from doc.object('RFC.Code.RFCClass') as rfc where rfc.number is not null order by rfc.number desc").setLimit(10).execute()) #set ($nextNumber = 1) #foreach ($highestPageName in $highestNumbered) #set ($highestPage = $xwiki.getDocument($highestPageName)) #if ($highestPage && $highestPage.getObject($rfcClassName)) #set ($highestNumber = $highestPage.getObject($rfcClassName).getValue('number')) #if ("$!highestNumber" != '') #set ($nextNumber = $mathtool.add($highestNumber, 1)) #break #end #end #end #set ($discard = $rfcObject.set('number', $nextNumber)) #end {{html wiki="true" clean="false"}}
